subject.title: Feature Request: First-class Projects in Gateway Dashboard (workspace + skill scoping + runtime constraints)

question: What first-class Project MVP should OpenClaw own in core, and should project-scoped tools, skills, workspaces, and runtime constraints be warn-only metadata or enforced policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but storage ownership, Gateway protocol contract, dashboard hierarchy, upgrade behavior, and security semantics require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Core Projects MVP
options.body: Add a narrow core Project store, additive `projects.*` Gateway methods, Projects UI, project-to-home-session/workspace bindings, and warn-only constraint display first.

options.title: Session Grouping Only
options.body: Limit the first iteration to labels, tree grouping, or shortcuts over existing sessions and agents while deferring Project storage and enforcement.

options.title: Defer Core Project Surface
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin/API gap is identified, accepting that first-class Projects will not be part of the dashboard for now.

recommendation.title: Core Projects MVP
recommendation.body: Add a narrow core Project store, additive `projects.*` Gateway methods, Projects UI, project-to-home-session/workspace bindings, and warn-only constraint display first.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing owner from CONTRIBUTING.md, prior issue discussion, and current Gateway/session provenance.
